description: Regulatory deadlines with dates: consultation response dates, compliance deadlines, and rule effective dates, filterable by date range, status, firm type, jurisdiction and regulator. This is the tool for "what is coming up for my firm" and for building a compliance calendar. Status is derived at query time, never stored, so it is always current; buckets do not overlap (within_90 excludes anything already within 30 days). Set high_confidence_only when the answer will be planned against.

content_types.description: Kind of document the deadline came from.

deadline_types.description: response_due = consultation closes; compliance_deadline = firms must have complied; effective_date = rule takes effect.

firm_types.description: Records tagged "All Firms" are cross-cutting and match every firm-type filter.

high_confidence_only.description: Only deadlines extracted with high confidence. Worth setting when the answer will be planned against — a wrong date is worse than no date.

status.description: Derived from the date at query time, never stored. "within_90" means within 90 days but not within 30 — the buckets do not overlap. Omit this and pass from/to for a plain date range.

name: regmonitoring_list_deadlines
title: List regulatory deadlines
